name: NEXO Brain
description: Cognitive memory for AI agents. Implements Atkinson-Shiffrin multi-store memory (sensory → STM → LTM), semantic RAG with fastembed, Ebbinghaus forgetting curves, trust scoring, and metacognitive guard. 76+ MCP tools. 100% local, MIT licensed.
